verdict.rationale: Quo generates AI insights from the user's own call data inside the product: recorded calls are transcribed and summarized, AI call tags are offered, and summaries are attached to the call record, though only on business and scale plans. The MCP and Claude/ChatGPT connectors produce summaries in an external agent, not inside Quo, so they are not credited here. Missing for 10: any documented AI-generated suggestions or recommendations, insights beyond individual call summaries and tags (e.g. across messages or the whole workspace, since 'Spot issues before they cost your business' is too vague to credit), availability on all plans, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Recorded calls come back transcribed and summarized, so no detail is missed and nobody has to take notes.
Call summaries are only available on business and scale plans.
